stem: For a G.P. \(a = \frac{4}{3}\) and \(t_7 = \frac{243}{1024}\), find the value of \(r\).
solution: [Textbook incompleteness: solving gives \(r^6 = \left(\dfrac{3}{4}\right)^6\), and because the index is EVEN this admits \(r = \pm\dfrac{3}{4}\). The printed key gives only the positive branch. Both are stated above. Contrast Misc II Q22, where \(r^3 = \dfrac{1}{27}\) has an odd index and the real cube root is genuinely unique, so no branch is lost there.]
